teaser: This issue is dominated by nursing education, with student AI literacy and use patterns studied across China, Korea, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and Mediterranean universities. Several papers examine how students actually use generative AI, from distinct usage personas to links between AI dependence and lower achievement motivation. Others test education tools directly, comparing GenAI-assisted debriefing to facilitator-led methods and AI-simulated patients to traditional practice. A smaller set of papers builds machine learning prediction models for frailty, delirium, and haemorrhage, and tests LLMs for detecting spiritual pain and screening curriculum content, generally finding good accuracy but a continued need for human review and external validation.

themes.name: Student AI literacy, use patterns, and dependence
AI tools in nursing education and simulation
